fit_decision_checklist.boundary: This career is a poor fit for shy people, anyone sensitive to rejection, or workers who need a stable base salary. Income depends on daily conditions, and rejection is routine in every kind of weather.

Repeat customers and reputation build stable traffic. With capital, sellers can upgrade the stall, register a business, or move into livestream commerce.
fit_decision_checklist.suit: This career suits confident, energetic people with strong social instincts. If you can handle doors closing in your face and explain a product's value in one sentence, the work can fit you well.

personality_fit_block.callout: If you can accept no base salary, outdoor work in all weather, and routine rejection but enjoy closing sales through personal skill, this career is worth exploring.

fit_decision_checklist.boundary: This work does not suit people who dislike dirt and oil, cannot stay focused, or do not want to keep learning new models. Repair work requires continuous learning as equipment changes, and oil residue is a permanent part of the environment.
fit_decision_checklist.how: A common path is: vocational school in automotive repair/agricultural machinery → repair shop apprentice → learn disassembly and tuning from an experienced mechanic → independently repair small gasoline engines → electric equipment maintenance or shop ownership.
fit_decision_checklist.suit: This work suits hands-on, patient people who enjoy machinery and do not mind oil. If you are willing to spend half a day lying down to find one small oil leak, this occupation fits you.

personality_fit_block.callout: If you enjoy disassembling and rebuilding machinery until it runs again and cannot sit still in an office, this work provides tangible satisfaction.
personality_fit_block.disclaimer: This match is a theoretical, probabilistic reference, not a deterministic judgment. Individual differences are significant. Use it only as a self-assessment aid.
traits: Dexterous: disassembly and adjustment require precise control
Practical: results-oriented; successful repair is the goal
Resilient under pressure: remains composed when customers need equipment urgently
